paraphrase: The bodhisattva vow is to be taken from a teacher who keeps and understands it and is competent; the four root downfalls (as in the Bodhisattvabhūmi) and forty-six lesser faults are to be avoided; a downfall committed with strong affliction destroys the vow, which may be taken again; lesser faults are confessed.
notes: Summary of the whole text; the count of forty-six lesser faults is the Tibetan commentarial count.
